**Step Title: Using the square of $$critic_1$$ as the predictor variable.**

**Hint 1:** Consider how the model equation is structured. The predictor variable is the square of $$critic_1$$, which means any changes to $$critic_1$$ will affect the predictor variable and potentially alter the model's parameters, including $\hat{	heta}_1$.

**Hint 2:** Think about the relationship between the predictor variable and the response variable. If the predictor variable changes, it can lead to a different fit of the model to the data, which would result in a change in the estimated parameter $\hat{	heta}_1$.
